full.scaling: none: 24 h at 1x fixture cadence on the wall clock, 3 symbols, sample every 60 s; memory baseline = hour 2 (fraction 0.0833)

smoke.scaling: 90 s of scenario time on a virtual clock (runs ~20x faster than 1x on the laptop), sample every 5 s, after an unsampled warm-up of 120 s of scenario time and at least 2 s of wall time (the recent-trades buffer is full at 20 s and the dedupe set's first growth step, at about 98 s at 50 prints a second, is past); flatness baseline at the same 1/12 fraction of the sampled window (t=7.5 s)
